objective: Apply the nearby-sector replication process to all dividend low-volatility, operating-cash-flow and sector-approved free-cash-flow sectors without prematurely promoting strategies.

basket_core_shadow_pool.allowed_next_action: Refresh PIT panels, low-vol factors, dividends, daily logs and platform-attribution inputs while keeping frozen strategy logic unchanged.
basket_core_shadow_pool.forbidden_action: Do not tune factor weights, target count, guards or promote accepted status from historical backtest evidence.

manual_research_before_formal.allowed_next_action: Build industry knowledge, business-purity evidence, PIT field map, FCF/capex-quality gate and source register before Quant validation.
manual_research_before_formal.forbidden_action: Do not run formal modeling before the data availability gate is passed.

batch_initial_validation.allowed_next_action: Run formal validation only after Research has supplied a finance-explainable hypothesis and PIT-safe panel.
batch_initial_validation.forbidden_action: Do not change financial theory or tune parameters by return.

observation_only.allowed_next_action: Keep as observation sleeve, specialist sleeve, or paper-only tracker until PM approves a special sample policy.
observation_only.forbidden_action: Do not use broad cross-sectional IC acceptance standards when sample size or specialist data makes them invalid.

blocked_data_repair.allowed_next_action: Repair missing PIT data, external state data, business-exposure evidence or original-report review.
blocked_data_repair.forbidden_action: Do not build or backtest a strategy while the hard data gate is blocked.
